blocks.text: Jannik Sinner risks missing the Australian Open after confirming on Tuesday that he has undergone surgery on his troublesome right knee. The five-time Grand Slam champion has not played a match since winning Wimbledon for the second time in July, with less than two months until the start of the first major tournament of the season in Melbourne. “Over the past few months, together with my team we’ve tried everything to treat my injury without surgery,” Sinner said in a statement.
